description.en: Open the Explorer at Dimetrodon to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开异齿龙，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 哺乳动物起源出现窗口

description.en: Open a source-bounded Mammal origins time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的哺乳动物起源时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 哺乳动物起源证据比较

description.en: Compare dimetrodon and morganucodonta through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较dimetrodon与morganucodonta；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 达善沟基干兽孔类样本窗口

description.en: Open the 269.34 Ma midpoint of the 274.4–264.28 Ma Xidagou Formation sample for Raranimus dashankouensis (IVPP V15424) to inspect bounded occurrence context in the map; this route is an evidence aid, not a direct date or ancestry claim.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 Raranimus dashankouensis（IVPP V15424）274.4–264.28 Ma 西达沟组样本的 269.34 Ma 中点，检查有界的出现背景；此路由用于证据检查，不是直接测年或祖先关系声明。

limitations: The mapped markers are bounded package samples; 269.34 Ma is a routing age within the cited Xidagou window, not a specimen date, global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, causal mechanism, or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: 哈拉米亚兽泰特山样本窗口

description.en: Open the 203.55 Ma midpoint of the 205.7–201.4 Ma Tait Bjerg Beds sample for Haramiyavia clemmenseni in the map, retaining its East Greenland formation context; the window does not turn jaw evidence into a crown-Mammalia date.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 Haramiyavia clemmenseni 东格陵兰 Tait Bjerg Beds 样本 205.7–201.4 Ma 范围的 203.55 Ma 中点，并保留地层背景；该窗口不会把颌骨证据转换为冠群哺乳动物起源日期。

limitations: The mapped markers are bounded package samples; 203.55 Ma routes within the Tait Bjerg Beds envelope and does not establish a specimen date, global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, crown-Mammalia origin, direct ancestry, causal mechanism, or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: 热河真三尖齿兽九佛堂样本窗口

description.en: Open the 117.3 Ma midpoint of the 121.4–113.2 Ma Jiufotang Formation envelope for Liaoconodon hui (IVPP V16051) to inspect sampled occurrence context; detached ear elements and ossified Meckel’s cartilage remain anatomical evidence, not a universal transition.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 Liaoconodon hui（IVPP V16051）121.4–113.2 Ma 九佛堂组范围的 117.3 Ma 中点，检查采样出现背景；分离的耳骨与骨化梅克尔软骨仍是解剖证据，不是普遍转变。

limitations: The mapped markers are bounded package samples; 117.3 Ma routes within the Jiufotang envelope, while the ear and dentary anatomy remains specimen-bounded and does not establish global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, causal mechanism, or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: 摩尔根兽类早侏罗世窗口

description.en: Open the 173.2 Ma midpoint of the 201.4–145 Ma source-bounded Morganucodonta sample to inspect the Wales-and-China skull context; this map preset does not infer an order-wide range or a linear jaw-to-ear transition.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 201.4–145 Ma 有来源边界的摩尔根兽类样本 173.2 Ma 中点，检查威尔士与中国颅骨背景；该预设不推断目级完整范围或线性的颌骨—中耳转变。

limitations: The mapped markers are bounded package samples; 173.2 Ma is only a routing age inside the broad matrix-sample envelope, and the Wales/China records do not establish global FAD/LAD, complete order distribution, direct ancestry, causal mechanism, or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: 原颌兽类矩阵样本窗口

description.en: Open the 205.85 Ma midpoint of the 237–174.7 Ma source-bounded Probainognathia matrix coverage to inspect sampled occurrence context; the route visualizes an age window, not a clade origin or direct lineage to Mammalia.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 237–174.7 Ma 有来源边界的原颌兽类矩阵覆盖 205.85 Ma 中点，检查采样出现背景；该路由显示的是时间窗口，不是该类群起源或通往哺乳动物的直接谱系。

limitations: The mapped markers are bounded package samples; 205.85 Ma is a routing age within sampled matrix coverage and does not establish a clade origin, global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, causal mechanism, or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.
